description: 法式温纳瓦C19 — 关键时机：压力下c4锁定与Ng5进攻时机

intro.popup_en:
Key Timing, Practice 8: French Winawer
White's queen on g4 and h5 creates kingside threats. How can Black find counterplay under pressure? Identify when to castle, when to lock White's bishop with ...c4, and when to launch ...f5.
intro.popup:
关键时机练习8

法式温纳瓦进攻！

白方Qg4/Qh5形成王侧威胁
黑方如何在压力下找到时机？

练习目标：
识别c4和f5的最佳时机

outro.popup_en: Timing sequence: ...O-O removes the immediate threat; ...c4 locks White's bishop; ...f5 launches the flank counterattack; then Ng5 is White's chance to strike back. Keep looking for the right moment even while defending.
outro.popup:
温纳瓦时机总结

时机节点：
① O-O：王侧易位消除威胁
② c4！：锁定白方象
③ f5！：启动翼攻反击
④ Ng5！：白方抓住时机

防守中寻找时机！

moves.popup_en: e5 advances and attacks on the kingside.
a3 challenges the bishop and asks it to decide.
...Bxc3+ gives up the bishop for the knight.
Qg4! White threatens the pawn on g7.

moves.popup:
O-O！时机！
易位消除威胁
moves.popup_en: ...O-O! Black castles at the right moment, removing the immediate threat to g7.
...Ng6 develops and challenges the queen's position.
...c4! Black locks White's bishop on e2 and fixes the position before counterattacking.
Be2 is restricted by the locked pawn structure.
...f5! With the position fixed by ...c4, Black launches a flank counterattack.
Re1 places a rook on the e-file.
...Rf8 brings the rook back to defend.

moves.popup:
Ng5！时机！
黑方f8车回防后白方反击
moves.popup_en: Ng5! With Black's rook back on f8, White seizes the moment to counterattack.
